sentences.en: His opinion does not arouse any echo in his colleagues.
sentences.zh: 他的观点在同事中没有引起任何共鸣。

sentences.en: "Oh, why doesn't she hear me," Echo thought to himself.
sentences.zh: ‘哦，为什么她听不到我。’回声自言自语道。

sentences.en: Your life is the echo of your way of thinking.
sentences.zh: 你的生活是你思维方式的反映。
